CL_ATGMWCSTG_2021.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
CL_ATGMWCSTG_2021.status_note: Incorporated into the TG (2024 Edition) 已納入技術指引 2024 年版
points: TG amendments (Oct 2021): **paras 3.3.1 and 3.24.1** add **APP-164** above-ground drainage requirements (e.g. traps and anti-siphonage; vent pipes ≥ 1 m above roof, consider **3 m above an accessible roof**); **paras 3.3.2 and 3.15.2** refer to **Foundations Code s 2.4** for drains and fence walls on **newly reclaimed land**.
技術指引修訂（2021 年 10 月）：3.3.1 及 3.24.1 段加入 **APP-164** 地面以上排水規定（如通風管高出天台 1 米，可到達天台建議 **3 米**）；3.3.2 及 3.15.2 段引用地基守則 2.4 節（**新填海土地**排水及圍牆）。

A GBP site may include only land the applicant **owns or has a realistic prospect of controlling**. Typical acceptable situations (Appendix): (a) authorised by the registered owners; (b) a registered owner authorised by all others; (c) **District Lands Conference** in-principle approval of a land grant; (d) in-principle approval of a licence by a department; (e) acceptance of LandsD basic terms or payment of the land exchange admin fee; (f) lease from the registered owner who authorises development; (g) **IO** for A&A forming a new building on common parts; (h) binding provisional sale and purchase agreement with all owners; (i) ownership enough for a **compulsory sale order** application (solicitor's letter and LR proof; possible B(P)R 20/21 modification on a **notional site** basis with a **2-year non-renewable** limit).

一般建築圖則的地盤只可包括申請人**擁有或有實際機會控制**的土地。附錄列出可接受情況：(a) 獲登記業主授權；(b) 業主之一並獲其他業主授權；(c) **地政總署地區地政會議**原則上批准批地；(d) 部門原則上批出牌照；(e) 已接受基本條款或繳付換地行政費；(f) 向業主租用並獲授權發展；(g) 法團於公用部分加建新建築物；(h) 與所有業主簽訂具約束力臨時買賣合約；(i) 擁有足夠業權申請**強制售賣令**（可按「**概念地盤**」修改 B(P)R 第 20、21 條，限期 **2 年**不可續）。

CL_ACOPSUS2011_2021.status_note: Incorporated into the Steel Code (2021 and 2023 Editions) 已納入鋼結構守則
points: Steel Code amendments (May 2021): symbol **λeff** (cl 1.5); yield strength definition (3.1.2); **BS EN 10268** replaces withdrawn BS 1449 (Table 3.9); revised effective slenderness about minor axes (8.7.9); **no WPS submission** before welding cold-formed hollow sections (11.7.5(iii)); conditions for welding cold-formed areas (Table 11.5); using the latest version of Annex A standards; adds **BS EN 10147:2000** and **BS EN 10268:2006**.
鋼結構守則修訂（2021 年 5 月）：新增 λeff 符號；屈服強度定義；以 BS EN 10268 取代 BS 1449；修訂有效長細比；冷成型空心型材焊接前毋須提交焊接程序規格；附錄 A 標準可用最新版本。

CL_RPNAPSOGNRL2021.status_note: APP-103 repealed 12 May 2021 已廢除 APP-103
points: **PNAP APP-103** (Structures On Grade on Newly Reclaimed Land) **repealed** at once: the **Foundations Code 2017** now covers structures on grade on newly reclaimed land, and APP-103 App. A details are no longer applicable – measures against soil migration under raft pile caps are considered **case by case**.
**APP-103（新填海土地上的地面結構）即時廢除**：地基守則已涵蓋相關指引；防止樁帽下泥土流失的措施按個別情況考慮。

CL_COPS2009_2021.status_note: Superseded by the Site Supervision Code 2024 Edition 已由 2024 年版取代
points: Promulgates the **Site Supervision Code 2009 (2021 Edition)**, consolidating corrigenda and amendments of May 2015, Jun 2016, May 2019, Sep and Dec 2020, with minor amendments: new para **4.1** General Principles (from 6.25); **natural terrain hazard mitigation** added to 7.1(a); Table 8.1 wording; TCPs keep **their own copy of supervision reports** with identity recorded (10.2); new samples (App. V, VI); TCP qualifications with **geology** background (App. VII).

Timeframes: **MBI 1** (appointment of RI) within **7 days** of appointment; **MBI 3a / MBI 3** (inspection certificate, without/with repair) within **7 days** after inspection; **MBI 2** (nomination of another RI for repair) within **7 days**; **MBI 4** (repair certificate) within **14 days** after repair; **MBI 5** (no business connection) within **14 days** after repair. Breaches → disciplinary action under BO s 7.
強制驗樓遲交。時限：**MBI 1**（委任）委任後 **7 日**；**MBI 3a／3**（檢驗證明書）檢驗後 **7 日**；**MBI 2**（提名另一檢驗人員）**7 日**；**MBI 4**（修葺證明書）修葺後 **14 日**；**MBI 5**（無業務關連）**14 日**。違者可被紀律處分。

CL_ACPF2017_2021.status_note: Incorporated into the Foundations Code 2024 Edition 已納入地基守則 2024 年版
points: Foundations Code amendments (Feb 2021): glossary **minor or temporary structures** (1.2) and their footings (2.2.2(5)); **category 2 rock** definition (Table 2.1); max effective overburden depth (2.2.4); **settlement and rotation reference criteria** (2.3.2(2)); note on accidental loads (2.5.4(1)); shallow foundation testing (4.2.2(2)); non-recognised piling systems (5.1.1); NSF alternative approach (5.2.3(c)); H-piles to bedrock founding materials and alternative to dynamic load tests (5.4.11).
